name: Obat Helpers
mission: Our mission is to equip underserved communities in Bangladesh with the tools they need to break free from the cycle of poverty. We do this by providing access to quality education and economic empowerment programs, promoting financial independence and inclusive economic growth. Our ultimate goal is to build a more equitable and prosperous Bangladesh for all.
theoryOfChange: OBAT's principal goal is to empower displaced and refugee communities through education, health and other empowerment initiatives.In order to empower the IDP camp residents and Rohingya refugees, OBAT has the following goals that it intends to achieve within the next 2-4 years.• Develop and enhance its donor base• Increase board members and enhance effectiveness of the board.• Expand the program services to cover more camp areas and people served and improve the quality of current programs• Attract nongovernmental funding, corporate and matching grants.• Employ newer and more current tools for fundraising.• Strengthen internal systems within the organization.• Increase media presence to promote organization's work• Enhance the volunteer pool

rich_narrative.summary: Founded in 2004, Obat Helpers works to break the cycle of poverty for displaced and refugee communities in Bangladesh [1, 12]. The organization provides critical education, healthcare, and economic empowerment programs [11]. In FY2024, the charity reported <cite id="12">$1,591,131 in total revenue</cite>, representing a decline from <cite id="3">$2,184,558 reported in FY2023</cite>. Despite this revenue contraction, the charity maintains strong financial allocation, directing an <cite id="12">84.8% program expense ratio</cite> toward direct service delivery. The organization holds <cite id="1">a 90.3/100 overall score from Charity Navigator</cite> and maintains <cite id="2">a Platinum Seal of Transparency</cite>. Donations to the charity are <cite id="2">zakat-eligible</cite>, allowing Muslim donors to support displaced populations through verified religious giving.
